name: OpenBlast v2.0.1 (Android TV Edition)
highlights: [Android TV & Google TV] Dedicated 10-foot Leanback interface optimized for TV remotes and D-pad navigation
[Remote Seeking & Control] Precision directional navigation with instant play, pause, and track hopping
[QR Code Sign-In] Pair instantly with phone without on-screen TV keyboard typing
[High-Fidelity Audio] 48 kHz Opus direct DAC playback for home theaters and soundbars
[Downloader Sideload] Fully compatible with Downloader app and USB sideloading on all Android TV boxes

name: OpenBlast v1.0.5 (iOS Edition)
highlights: [AltStore & SideStore] On-device sideloading with automated certificate renewal and zero revokes
[SwiftUI Native Player] Fluid gesture-driven interface designed specifically for iOS 16 and iOS 17/18
[Word-Synced Lyrics] Swift-rendered real-time lyrics synchronization matching YouTube Music
[AirPlay & Lock Screen] Integrated Now Playing info center, Control Center scrubbing, and AirPlay 2 streaming
[Source Catalog] Direct SideStore repository URL: https://openblast.vercel.app/ios/source.json

name: OpenBlast v2.0.1

[In-App Updater] Hardened APK integrity validation with ZIP structure checks before installation
[Listen Together] Perfect multi-device audio synchronization: eliminated 1-5s playback drift
[Library] Persistent playlist sorting: A-Z order remembered across restarts with save order option
[Contributors] Akshay, Akhil, and Ganesh added as official Testers & Promoters
